description: The analytic axes of a company — a cost centre, a project, a site, a business unit — each with its values, which may nest under a parent_id, and required_on: none, or expense, income or result — the lines that must carry the axis whole, or posting refuses them (analytic_axis_required). A value says what a cost, a revenue or a fixed asset is for; a product says what was sold or bought. A retired value takes no new share. Read it before analytic_report, which takes an axis by its code.

company_id.description: The company to work in. Ask list_companies if unsure.
